title: षट्सप्ततितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 76 · Sixth day: the Makara array

summary.en: The weary armies rest and rise again; Dhrishtadyumna forms the Makara (crocodile) array, which Bhima enters and breaks. Both hosts roar as the weapons rattle.
summary.kn: ದಣಿದ ಸೈನ್ಯಗಳು ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ ಪಡೆದು ಮತ್ತೆ ಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ; ಧೃಷ್ಟದ್ಯುಮ್ನ ಮಕರವ್ಯೂಹ ರಚಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಭೀಮ ಅದನ್ನು ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸಿ ಒಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಎರಡೂ ಸೈನ್ಯಗಳು ಆಯುಧ ಝಣತ್ಕಾರದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಗರ್ಜಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.
summary.hi: थकी सेनाएँ विश्राम कर फिर तैयार होती हैं; धृष्टद्युम्न मकर व्यूह बनाते हैं जिसमें भीम घुसकर तोड़ते हैं। शस्त्रों की झनकार के साथ दोनों दल गरजते हैं।
summary.te: అలసిన సేనలు విశ్రాంతి తీసుకుని మళ్లీ సిద్ధమవుతాయి; ధృష్టద్యుమ్నుడు మకర వ్యూహం పన్నగా భీముడు అందులో ప్రవేశించి ఛేదిస్తాడు. ఆయుధాల ఘంటారవంతో ఇరు సేనలు గర్జిస్తాయి.
summary.ta: களைத்த படைகள் ஓய்வெடுத்து மீண்டும் தயாராகின்றன; த்ருஷ்டத்யும்னன் மகர வியூகம் அமைக்க, பீமன் அதில் புகுந்து பிளக்கிறான். ஆயுத முழக்கத்துடன் இரு படைகளும் கர்ஜிக்கின்றன.
summary.ml: ക്ഷീണിച്ച സേനകൾ വിശ്രമിച്ച് വീണ്ടും ഉണരുന്നു; ധൃഷ്ടദ്യുമ്നൻ മകര (മുതല) വ്യൂഹം ഒരുക്കുന്നു, അതിൽ കടന്ന് ഭീമൻ അതിനെ ഭേദിക്കുന്നു. ആയുധങ്ങൾ കിലുങ്ങുമ്പോൾ ഇരുസേനകളും ഗർജിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 6.76; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 26 2021

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
अथ शूरा महाराज परस्परकृतागसः ।
जग्मुः स्वशिबिराण्येव रुधिरेण समुक्षिताः ॥

meaning.en: Then the warriors, O great king, each having wounded the other, went to their own camps, soaked in blood.

verses.text:
विश्रम्य च यथान्यायं पूजयित्वा परस्परम् ।
संनद्धाः समदृश्यन्त भूयो युद्धचिकीर्षया ॥

meaning.en: After resting properly and honoring one another, they were seen armored again, wishing to fight once more.

verses.text:
ततस्तव सुतो राजंश्चिन्तयाभिपरिप्लुतः ।
विस्रवच्छोणिताक्ताङ्गः पप्रच्छेदं पितामहम् ॥

meaning.en: Then your son, O king, overwhelmed with worry, his limbs smeared with flowing blood, asked his grandfather Bhishma this.

verses.text:
सैन्यानि रौद्राणि भयानकानि
व्यूढानि सम्यग्बहुलध्वजानि ।
विदार्य हत्वा च निपीड्य शूरा-
स्ते पाण्डवानां त्वरिता रथौघाः ॥

meaning.en: Those fearful and terrible armies of ours, well arrayed with many banners, were broken, killed and crushed by the Pandavas' swift hosts of chariots.

verses.text:
संमोह्य सर्वान्युधि कीर्तिमन्तो
व्यूहं च तं मकरं वज्रकल्पम् ।
प्रविश्य भीमेन निबर्हितोऽस्मि
घोरैः शरैर्मृत्युदण्डप्रकाशैः ॥

meaning.en: Confusing everyone in the battle, those famed men entered that Makara formation, hard as a thunderbolt, and I was struck down by Bhima with terrible arrows like staffs of death.

verses.text:
क्रुद्धं तमुद्वीक्ष्य भयेन राज-
न्संमूर्छितो नालभं शान्तिमद्य ।
इच्छे प्रसादात्तव सत्यसंध
प्राप्तुं जयं पाण्डवेयांश्च हन्तुम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him enraged, O king, I fainted from fear and found no peace today. By your grace, truthful one, I want to win and to kill the sons of Pandu.

verses.text:
तेनैवमुक्तः प्रहसन्महात्मा
दुर्योधनं जातमन्युं विदित्वा ।
तं प्रत्युवाचाविमना मनस्वी
गङ्गासुतः शस्त्रभृतां वरिष्ठः ॥

meaning.en: Spoken to thus, the great-souled son of Ganga, best of weapon-bearers, laughed, and knowing Duryodhana was filled with anger, he replied unperturbed and wise.

verses.text:
परेण यत्नेन विगाह्य सेनां
सर्वात्मनाहं तव राजपुत्र ।
इच्छामि दातुं विजयं सुखं च
न चात्मानं छादयेऽहं त्वदर्थे ॥

meaning.en: Prince, entering the enemy army with the greatest effort and with my whole self, I wish to give you victory and happiness, and I do not spare myself for your sake.

verses.text:
एते तु रौद्रा बहवो महारथा
यशस्विनः शूरतमाः कृतास्त्राः ।
ये पाण्डवानां समरे सहाया
जितक्लमाः क्रोधविषं वमन्ति ॥

meaning.en: But these many fearsome great chariot-warriors, famous, very brave and skilled in weapons, who help the Pandavas in battle, have conquered weariness and spit the poison of rage.

verses.text:
ते नेह शक्याः सहसा विजेतुं
वीर्योन्नद्धाः कृतवैरास्त्वया च ।
अहं ह्येतान्प्रतियोत्स्यामि राज-
न्सर्वात्मना जीवितं त्यज्य वीर ॥

meaning.en: They cannot be defeated suddenly, swollen with strength as they are and having been made enemies by you. But I will fight them with my whole self, O king, giving up my life.

verses.text:
रणे तवार्थाय महानुभाव
न जीवितं रक्ष्यतमं ममाद्य ।
सर्वांस्तवार्थाय सदेवदैत्याँ-
ल्लोकान्दहेयं किमु शत्रूंस्तवेह ॥

meaning.en: Noble one, in battle for your sake my life is not what I most care to protect. For you I could burn all worlds, with gods and demons, let alone your enemies here.

verses.text:
तत्पाण्डवान्योधयिष्यामि राज-
न्प्रियं च ते सर्वमहं करिष्ये ।
श्रुत्वैव चैतत्परमप्रतीतो
दुर्योधनः प्रीतमना बभूव ॥

meaning.en: So I will fight the Pandavas, O king, and do all that you wish. Hearing this, Duryodhana was greatly cheered and glad at heart.

verses.text:
सर्वाणि सैन्यानि ततः प्रहृष्टो
निर्गच्छतेत्याह नृपांश्च सर्वान् ।
तदाज्ञया तानि विनिर्ययुर्द्रुतं
रथाश्वपादातगजायुतानि ॥

meaning.en: Then, delighted, he told all the kings and all his forces to march out. At his command those armies of chariots, horses, foot and elephants quickly set out, in tens of thousands.

verses.text:
प्रहर्षयुक्तानि तु तानि राज-
न्महान्ति नानाविधशस्त्रवन्ति ।
स्थितानि नागाश्वपदातिमन्ति
विरेजुराजौ तव राजन्बलानि ॥

meaning.en: Those great armies, full of joy and carrying weapons of many kinds, with elephants, horses and foot, shone on the field, O king, as yours stood arrayed.

verses.text:
वृन्दैः स्थिताश्चापि सुसंप्रयुक्ता-
श्चकाशिरे दन्तिगणाः समन्तात् ।
शस्त्रास्त्रविद्भिर्नरदेव योधै-
रधिष्ठिताः सैन्यगणास्त्वदीयाः ॥

meaning.en: Herds of elephants, standing in groups and well prepared, shone on every side, ridden by warriors skilled in weapons and missiles, O king; your army divisions were splendid.

verses.text:
रथैश्च पादातगजाश्वसंघैः
प्रयाद्भिराजौ विधिवत्प्रणुन्नैः ।
समुद्धतं वै तरुणार्कवर्णं
रजो बभौ छादयत्सूर्यरश्मीन् ॥

meaning.en: As chariots, foot, elephants and horse masses advanced in the field, driven properly, the dust they raised, the color of the young sun, rose and covered the sun's rays.

verses.text:
रेजुः पताका रथदन्तिसंस्था
वातेरिता भ्राम्यमाणाः समन्तात् ।
नानारङ्गाः समरे तत्र राज-
न्मेघैर्युक्ता विद्युतः खे यथैव ॥

meaning.en: The banners on chariots and elephants, stirred by the wind, shone as they waved on every side, many-colored in that battle, O king, like lightning amid clouds in the sky.

verses.text:
धनूंषि विस्फारयतां नृपाणां
बभूव शब्दस्तुमुलोऽतिघोरः ।
विमथ्यतो देवमहासुरौघै-
र्यथार्णवस्यादियुगे तदानीम् ॥

meaning.en: The sound of the kings stretching their bows was tumultuous and very terrible, like the churning of the ocean by hosts of gods and great demons at the beginning of the age.

verses.text:
तदुग्रनादं बहुरूपवर्णं
तवात्मजानां समुदीर्णमेवम् ।
बभूव सैन्यं रिपुसैन्यहन्तृ
युगान्तमेघौघनिभं तदानीम् ॥

meaning.en: So rose the fierce roar of your sons' army, many-formed and many-colored, killer of enemy armies, like a mass of clouds at the end of the age.
